scope: Original network same-Client QUICK_MOVE on both modes/versions: storage reverse order, explicit locally closed player UI, auto-equipment and partial internal rounds of default pumpkin/diamond helmet with exact legacy constructor NBT. Nine completed actual transfers per version; independent native RCON inventory/storage/head equipment and unchanged position. Primitive 11226-case coverage is separate, not a network/mode/ownership proof.
runtime_source_status: Each actual pre-build source/data/consumer hash is retained separately below. Subsequent common source-name compatibility re-export, diagnostic wording and Java exporter comment edits do not alter the tested native operation paths; final compiler/tests/package check their current source separately.
authority_limits: Predictions never replace received slots; all changed slots require actual exact fresh receipts.
Unchanged cursor is inspected with its actual existing receive ordinal; QUICK_MOVE need not emit a fresh cursor packet.
Full write, matching actual legacy comparison reply and independent RCON results have different authority; false comparison is not rollback.
RCON player head equipment is version-specific serialized state: legacy Inventory Slot 103, modern equipment.head; public canonical player slot 5 stays common.
Admin fixture cleanup waits for two observed native ticks between independent play/RCON queues; these ticks are not a processing/gameplay ACK.
Matching OPEN has no target coordinates and does not prove causal target ownership.
General arbitrary NBT/components, crafting/general UI/recovery and wider movement remain outside these bounded scenarios.
